# ​D8.15.3 MMU faults generated by cache maintenance operations

Source: <https://developer.arm.com/documentation/ddi0487/mc/-Part-D-The-AArch64-System-Level-Architecture/-Chapter-D8-The-AArch64-Virtual-Memory-System-Architecture/-D8-15-Memory-aborts/-D8-15-3-MMU-faults-generated-by-cache-maintenance-operations>

##### D8.15.3 MMU faults generated by cache maintenance operations

I QZTRG
:   There are no alignment requirements in cache maintenance instructions and execution of these instructions cannot generate an Alignment fault.

I BDCCY
:   Cache maintenance instructions treated as a `NOP` cannot generate [MMU faults](/documentation/ddi0487/mc/-Part-D-The-AArch64-System-Level-Architecture/-Chapter-D8-The-AArch64-Virtual-Memory-System-Architecture/-D8-15-Memory-aborts?lang=en#aa64_mmu_fault).

R TRTWX
:   It is IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED whether execution of any cache maintenance instruction by VA that is not treated as a `NOP` can generate an Access flag fault.

R MXZPX
:   If [SCTLR\_ELx](/documentation/ddi0487/mc/-Part-K-Appendixes/-Appendix-K14-Registers-Index/-K14-1-Introduction-and-register-disambiguation/-K14-1-2-Register-name-disambiguation-by-Exception-level?lang=en#sctlr_elx).UCI is 1, enabling EL0 execution of the data cache maintenance instructions that operate by VA, then when the instruction is executed at EL0 to a location that does not have read permission at EL0, a Permission fault can be generated.

R XJRNW
:   If [SCTLR\_ELx](/documentation/ddi0487/mc/-Part-K-Appendixes/-Appendix-K14-Registers-Index/-K14-1-Introduction-and-register-disambiguation/-K14-1-2-Register-name-disambiguation-by-Exception-level?lang=en#sctlr_elx).UCI is 1, enabling EL0 execution of the [IC IVAU](/documentation/ddi0487/mc/-Part-C-The-AArch64-Instruction-Set/-Chapter-C5-The-A64-System-Instruction-Class/-C5-3-A64-System-instructions-for-cache-maintenance/-C5-3-41-IC-IVAU--Instruction-Cache-line-Invalidate-by-VA-to-PoU?lang=en#reg_aarch64_ic_ivau) instruction, and if the instruction is executed at EL0 to a location that does not have read permission at EL0, then it is IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED whether a Permission fault is generated.

R FTXTG
:   If the [Effective value](/documentation/ddi0487/mc/-Part-K-Appendixes/Glossary?lang=en#effective_value) of [SCTLR\_ELx](/documentation/ddi0487/mc/-Part-K-Appendixes/-Appendix-K14-Registers-Index/-K14-1-Introduction-and-register-disambiguation/-K14-1-2-Register-name-disambiguation-by-Exception-level?lang=en#sctlr_elx).CMOW is 1, execution of any of the following at EL0 without stage 1 write permission generates a stage 1 Permission fault:

    - Any DC instruction that operates by VA and performs clean and invalidate.
    - Any IC instruction that operates by VA.

R BBLTJ
:   If the [Effective value](/documentation/ddi0487/mc/-Part-K-Appendixes/Glossary?lang=en#effective_value) of [HCRX\_EL2](/documentation/ddi0487/mc/-Part-D-The-AArch64-System-Level-Architecture/-Chapter-D24-AArch64-System-Register-Descriptions/-D24-2-General-system-control-registers/-D24-2-62-HCRX-EL2--Extended-Hypervisor-Configuration-Register?lang=en#reg_aarch64_hcrx_el2).CMOW is 1, execution of any of the following at EL1 or EL0 without stage 2 write permission generates a stage 2 Permission fault:

    - Any DC instruction that operates by VA and performs clean and invalidate.
    - Any IC instruction that operates by VA.

I ZNSBH
:   When an implementation can generate [MMU faults](/documentation/ddi0487/mc/-Part-D-The-AArch64-System-Level-Architecture/-Chapter-D8-The-AArch64-Virtual-Memory-System-Architecture/-D8-15-Memory-aborts?lang=en#aa64_mmu_fault) on execution of cache maintenance operations, Permission faults are generated according to the type of cache maintenance operation and System register configuration.

R JQCHQ
:   If a stage 2 translation of a stage 1 translation table walk is done as part of a cache maintenance instruction, then a stage 2 Permission fault can be generated.

R JYWZL
:   If a DC Invalidate by address instruction, for example, [DC IVAC](/documentation/ddi0487/mc/-Part-C-The-AArch64-Instruction-Set/-Chapter-C5-The-A64-System-Instruction-Class/-C5-3-A64-System-instructions-for-cache-maintenance/-C5-3-37-DC-IVAC--Data-or-unified-Cache-line-Invalidate-by-VA-to-PoC?lang=en#reg_aarch64_dc_ivac), [DC IGVAC](/documentation/ddi0487/mc/-Part-C-The-AArch64-Instruction-Set/-Chapter-C5-The-A64-System-Instruction-Class/-C5-3-A64-System-instructions-for-cache-maintenance/-C5-3-35-DC-IGVAC--Invalidate-of-Allocation-Tags-by-VA-to-PoC?lang=en#reg_aarch64_dc_igvac), or [DC IGDVAC](/documentation/ddi0487/mc/-Part-C-The-AArch64-Instruction-Set/-Chapter-C5-The-A64-System-Instruction-Class/-C5-3-A64-System-instructions-for-cache-maintenance/-C5-3-33-DC-IGDVAC--Invalidate-of-Data-and-Allocation-Tags-by-VA-to-PoC?lang=en#reg_aarch64_dc_igdvac) is not treated as a `NOP` and does not have write permission to the location it invalidates, then a Permission fault is generated.

I XQZJB
:   [DC ZVA](/documentation/ddi0487/mc/-Part-C-The-AArch64-Instruction-Set/-Chapter-C5-The-A64-System-Instruction-Class/-C5-3-A64-System-instructions-for-cache-maintenance/-C5-3-38-DC-ZVA--Data-Cache-Zero-by-VA?lang=en#reg_aarch64_dc_zva) is not a cache maintenance instruction.

I LJLSP
:   For more information, see:

    - [Data and unified caches](/documentation/ddi0487/mc/-Part-D-The-AArch64-System-Level-Architecture/-Chapter-D8-The-AArch64-Virtual-Memory-System-Architecture/-D8-18-Caches/-D8-18-1-Data-and-unified-caches?lang=en#mdsec_data_and_unified_caches).
    - [Instruction caches](/documentation/ddi0487/mc/-Part-D-The-AArch64-System-Level-Architecture/-Chapter-D8-The-AArch64-Virtual-Memory-System-Architecture/-D8-18-Caches/-D8-18-2-Instruction-caches?lang=en#mdsec_instruction_caches).
    - [Memory aborts](/documentation/ddi0487/mc/-Part-D-The-AArch64-System-Level-Architecture/-Chapter-D8-The-AArch64-Virtual-Memory-System-Architecture/-D8-15-Memory-aborts?lang=en#mdsec_memory_aborts).
    - [Permission fault](/documentation/ddi0487/mc/-Part-D-The-AArch64-System-Level-Architecture/-Chapter-D8-The-AArch64-Virtual-Memory-System-Architecture/-D8-15-Memory-aborts/-D8-15-1-MMU-fault-types?lang=en#mdsec_permission_fault).
    - [A64 Cache maintenance instructions](/documentation/ddi0487/mc/-Part-D-The-AArch64-System-Level-Architecture/-Chapter-D7-The-AArch64-System-Level-Memory-Model/-D7-5-Cache-support/-D7-5-9-A64-Cache-maintenance-instructions?lang=en#chdbfich).
